title: Advanced Football Analytics: Expected Goals (xG), Expected Threat (xT) & Passing Networks
workplace_track: World Sports: Modern Football Analytics & Data Science
description: Data science and analytics module evaluating metric modeling (xG, xA, post-shot xG), progressive carries, pitch control models, and tactical recruitment scouting reports.
learning_objectives: Master modern football analytics nomenclature (understat, shot quality, non-penalty xG, progressive passes per 90, PPDA)
Construct complex comparative structures, data-driven hypotheses, and statistical interpretations
Avoid Czenglish errors when explaining performance regression, probability models, and scouting benchmarks

questions.prompt: The closer an attacker takes a shot to the center of the goal, _____ the calculated Expected Goals (xG) value becomes.

explanations.correct: Proportional comparative structure requires 'the closer..., the higher...'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'higher' without 'the' does not form a correlative comparative.
explanations.wrong_C: 'the more high' is ungrammatical for single-syllable adjectives.

questions.cz_learning_point: Úměrné porovnání (čím..., tím...) vyžaduje tvar 'the + komparativ..., the + komparativ': 'the closer..., the higher...'.
questions.workplace_track: World Sports: Modern Football Analytics & Data Science

questions.prompt: The scouting department discovered that the winger generates _____ progressive passes per 90 minutes than any other player in the division.

explanations.correct: 'Far more' correctly modifies comparative quantifier 'more' for countable plural nouns (passes).
explanations.wrong_C: 'very more' is a classic Czenglish error (*velmi více*); use 'far more' or 'much more'.
explanations.wrong_D: 'many more of' is redundant before the direct noun.

questions.cz_learning_point: Stupňování s 'more' se zesiluje pomocí 'far more' nebo 'much more' (nikdy *very more*).
questions.workplace_track: World Sports: Modern Football Analytics & Data Science

questions.prompt: The forward's sudden scoring drought is primarily attributable _____ negative variance and unsustainable finishing overperformance earlier in the campaign.

explanations.correct: Adjective 'attributable' strictly takes dependent preposition 'to' (attributable to).
explanations.wrong_B: 'attributable for' is ungrammatical in analytical prose.

questions.cz_learning_point: Přídavné jméno 'attributable' (přičitatelný) se váže výhradně s předložkou 'to': 'attributable to variance'.
questions.workplace_track: World Sports: Modern Football Analytics & Data Science

questions.prompt: Had the technical director consulted the post-shot xG metrics earlier, he _____ the goalkeeper's underlying shot-stopping decline.

explanations.correct: Inverted third conditional ('Had the director consulted...') requires 'would have noticed' in the result clause.
explanations.wrong_B: 'would notice' forms a Second Conditional mismatch.
explanations.wrong_D: 'will have noticed' is a future perfect form.

questions.cz_learning_point: Invertovaný 3. kondicionál bez 'if' ('Had he consulted...') vyžaduje v hlavní větě 'would have + minulé příčestí': 'would have noticed'.
questions.workplace_track: World Sports: Modern Football Analytics & Data Science

questions.prompt: The 21-year-old defensive midfielder, _____ passes per defensive action (PPDA) rank in the 99th percentile, fits our aggressive pressing philosophy.

explanations.correct: Relative possessive determiner 'whose' modifies the noun phrase 'passes per defensive action'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'whom' is an object pronoun, not a possessive modifier.
explanations.wrong_C: 'which' cannot indicate possession for an individual player.
explanations.wrong_D: 'that' cannot be used in non-defining relative clauses set off by commas.

questions.cz_learning_point: Přivlastňovací vztažné zájmeno je 'whose' (jehož metriky PPDA se řadí na 99. percentil). V přístavkových větách s čárkami se nesmí použít *that*.
questions.workplace_track: World Sports: Modern Football Analytics & Data Science

questions.prompt: _____ their 2.8 Expected Goals tally, the home side failed to convert their territorial dominance into three points.

explanations.correct: Preposition 'Notwithstanding' directly precedes the noun phrase 'their 2.8 Expected Goals tally'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'Although' is a conjunction requiring a full clause with subject and finite verb.
explanations.wrong_C: 'Even though' is a conjunction requiring a full subordinate clause.

questions.cz_learning_point: Předložka 'Notwithstanding' (nehledě na / navzdory) se pojí přímo s podstatným jménem. Spojky *Although* a *Even though* vyžadují celou větu se slovesem.
questions.workplace_track: World Sports: Modern Football Analytics & Data Science

questions.prompt: By _____ tracking data from positional optical cameras, analysts can model real-time pitch control across all 22 players.

explanations.correct: Prepositions ('By') must be followed by a gerund ('evaluating').
explanations.wrong_B: Base verb 'evaluate' cannot directly follow preposition 'By'.
explanations.wrong_D: Infinitive 'to evaluate' cannot follow a preposition.

questions.cz_learning_point: Po předložkách (by, for, without, after) má sloveso vždy tvar gerundia s koncovkou -ing: 'By evaluating tracking data'.
questions.workplace_track: World Sports: Modern Football Analytics & Data Science

questions.prompt: The data analyst delivered a presentation highlighting the _____ correlation between progressive passes and high xG chance creation.

explanations.correct: Adverb 'statistically' correctly modifies the participial adjective 'significant'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'significance' is a noun and cannot modify 'correlation'.
explanations.wrong_C: 'statistical significantly' reverses adverb and adjective positions.

questions.cz_learning_point: Příslovce rozvíjí přídavné jméno: 'statistically significant correlation' (statisticky významná korelace).
questions.workplace_track: World Sports: Modern Football Analytics & Data Science

questions.prompt: Given their extraordinarily high defensive line, the champions _____ conceding chances on rapid transitions if their counter-press fails.

explanations.correct: Verb 'risk' takes a gerund directly: 'risk conceding chances'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'are risk to' is completely ungrammatical in English.
explanations.wrong_C: Verb 'risk' cannot take an infinitive with 'to'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Sloveso 'risk' se pojí přímo s gerundiem bez předložky: 'risk conceding' (riskují obdržení šancí), nikdy *risk to concede*.
questions.workplace_track: World Sports: Modern Football Analytics & Data Science

questions.prompt: The striker's shot chart demonstrates that 85% of his attempts originate from _____ the penalty box.

explanations.correct: Preposition 'inside' denotes static location within the enclosed 18-yard penalty box.
explanations.wrong_B: 'inside of to' is an ungrammatical pile-up of prepositions.
explanations.wrong_D: 'in to' denotes direction rather than static origin.

questions.cz_learning_point: Pro vyjádření polohy uvnitř pokutového území použijte 'inside the penalty box' (uvnitř vápna).
